operations.title: Apply
operations.description: Apply the exact persisted plan after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Backup
operations.description: Create a local owner-custodied backup snapshot.

operations.title: Disable backup schedule
operations.description: Revoke the local backup timer after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Enable backup schedule
operations.description: Enable the CUE-governed local backup timer after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Backup schedule status
operations.description: Read the local backup timer and signed schedule authorization without changing either.

operations.title: Backup status
operations.description: Read repository readiness, authenticated receipt history, current snapshot availability and declared recovery objectives.

operations.title: Drift
operations.description: Observe desired-versus-applied standalone state drift.

operations.title: Generate
operations.description: Generate rollout artifacts from the exact persisted ResolvedPlan.

operations.title: Init
operations.description: Materialize a native StackSpec from the embedded CUE authoring contract.

operations.title: Logs
operations.description: List local structured rollout logs.

operations.title: Plan
operations.description: Inspect the persisted ResolvedPlan and generated artifact closure.

operations.title: Remove
operations.description: Remove one governed workload from its exact applied ResolvedPlan after local Owner approval.

operations.title: Resolve
operations.description: Resolve StackSpec and observed Inventory into the canonical ResolvedPlan.

operations.title: Restore
operations.description: Verify and restore one signed snapshot into isolated staging.

operations.title: Abandon restore
operations.description: Close one pending or staged restore journal with explicit local Owner approval without touching repository or live volumes.

operations.title: Set up application
operations.description: Set up and verify a Plan-declared app-local owner account on the existing application.

operations.title: Status
operations.description: Read the current standalone StackKits lifecycle status.

operations.title: Upgrade
operations.description: Resolve, verify, checkpoint, install, apply, and verify a StackKits release.

operations.title: Validate
operations.description: Validate desired StackSpec intent without mutating lifecycle state.

operations.title: Verify
operations.description: Verify desired, planned, applied, and observed local state.
